407)༄༅/byin rlabs dam rdzas kyi dkar chag stong thun nges shes 'dren byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /408)na mo gu ru sa ma dā na sarba sidhi hūm̐/rang bzha

tei:div.tei:p: .*407) ༄༅/ byin rlabs dam rdzas kyi dkar chag stong thun nges shes 'dren byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// 408) na mo gu ru sa ma dā na sarba sidhi hūm̐/ rang bzhin chos sku bde klong 'khyil ba'i dbyings// dbyings las ma g.yos gzugs sku'i thugs rje'i rtsal// rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i phrin las dngos grub char// char 'bebs bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas bla mar 'dud// thog ma med nas lhan skyes ma rig mun// mun klong 'khyams pa'i 'khor ba'i sems can tshogs// tshogs gnyis mngon gyur 'bras bu'i sar 'god thabs// thabs mchog bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'dir brjod bya// de la spyir 'khor ba dang myang 409) 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu gsum du ma 'dus pa med phyir/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi yang de gsum gyis bsdus pa'i sgo nas ston te/ de yang kun gzhi rgyu'i bdud rtsi/ lam thabs kyi bdud rtsi/ 'bras bu ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang gsum las/ dang po rgyu'i bdud rtsi la'ang gnyis te/ mtshon bya don gyi bdud rtsi dang mtshon byed rtags kyi bdud rtsi'o/ dang po mtshon bya don gyi bdud rtsi gang zhe na/ sems can gyi khams la khyab pa'i kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo nyid dang*/ de las byung 410)ba'i 'gyu byed phra rags bzang ngan gyi rtog tshogs mtha' dag gdams pa'i gnad kyis ma zin na las ngan 'khrul ba'i bag chags bskyed cing*/ de 'bras kyis khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bskyed phyir bdud yin la/ gnad kyis zin cing rtogs na bla med byang chub kyi 'bras bu smin par byed pa'i rtsi yin phyir bdud rtsi zhes bya ste/ che mchog 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ gang dag chags sogs srid pa'i gzhi// rigs gcig pa dang tha dad pa'i// nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs dag

/rang gi de gnyis yongs shes shing*// bag chags dang ni kun gyi gzhi// rnam par shes pa'i yul tshogs rnams// zag bcas zag med 'dus ma byas// rang bzhin 'byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das// dbang po'i longs spyod yul gyur rnams// de nyid shes pas yongs bsgrub pas// nga yi yon tan mthong ba yin/ zhes dang*/ bdag 'dzin rnam dag ye shes sku// chags bral 411)skye med chos kyi dbyings// gnyis med don las sna tshogs ston// 'di ni don gyi bdud rtsi yin/ zhes gsungs shing*/ mtshon byed rtags kyi bdud rtsi ni/ gdos bcas kyi lus las rang byung gi bdud rtsi lnga rang babs su 'byung ba 'di dag kyang lam khyer gyi gnad mi shes pa rnams kyi snang ngor dri chen dri chu khu ba rak+ta la sogs mi gtsang ba'i dngos po ltar snang yang*/ rnal 'byor ldan pa rnams la mchog gi bdud rtsir lhun gyis grub pa nyid de/ rgyud las/ ye shes sku lnga rdzogs pa'i phyir// dri chen gser mdog rnam snang mdzad// mngon byung sprul pa chos kyi sku// byang chub sems ni dkar ba'i mdog dri med dag pa ye shes sku// maṃ sa yid bzhin rin chen gter// sna tshogs 'byung gnas mnyam nyid sku// rak+ta chags med dmar bas na// dri med rnam dag pad+ma'i sku// dri chu dag byed ljang khu'i 412) mdog /kun tu don grub las rab sku// sku lnga lhun grub bdud rtsi lnga// rang gi lus la ngang gis gnas// thams cad ma lus sangs rgyas lnga/ lus pa med par ye shes sku// ma bcos ye shes de nyid do// de phyir sman ni bcud kyi mchog /bdud rtsi zhes ni de la bya// zhes gsungs phyir de kho na nyid kyi don shes pa gal che zhing*/ gnyis pa lam thabs kyi bdud rtsi la yang gnyis te/ 'byung ba lhun grub kyi bdud rtsi dang sgrub pa dam rdzas kyi bdud rtsi'o/ dang po 'byung ba lhun grub kyi bdud rtsi ni snod kyi 'jig rten sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal sngo ldum me tog rtsa ba 'bras bu la sogs thams cad dang*/

bcud kyi sems can mkha' la 'phur rgu/ sa la 'dzul rgu/ rang bzhin gnas rgu mtha' dag gi sha khrag rkang rus la sogs ma lus gtsang dme med par bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du lhun gyis grub pa kho na ste/ 413)rgyud las/ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad kun// bdud rtsi lnga yi rang bzhin te// so so rang rig rtsa ba brgyad// dbyibs dang kha dog phyi nang dang*// thabs dang shes rab ro dang nus// sku dang gsung dang thugs nyid dang*// yon tan phrin las yan lag stong*/ /ngang dang rang bzhin bdag nyid sku// dus gsum de nyid shes pas spyod// bdud rtsi nyon mongs nad sel 'joms/ ces dang*/ de bzhin bshegs pa'i byin rlabs las// sa gzhi yum gyi rang bzhin la// byang chub sems kyi char babs pas// thams cad smin cing gang bar mdzad// chu bo bcud las gyes pa yis// bdud rtsir gyur nas thams cad rgyas// rtsa ba sdong bu yal ga dang*/ yon tan stong dang bcas pa yis// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad sel zhing*// 'gro ba drug gi gsos su gyur/ ces sogs gsungs pas snang srid thams cad bdud rtsi kho na'i rang bzhin las ma 'das so/ gnyis pa bsgrubs 414)pa rdzas kyi bdud rtsi ni/ rgyud sde so so'i lugs kyi bsgrub thabs mang yang bsdu na gnyis su 'dus te/ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar la brten nas sman mchog a mṛ ta phyi ma nyid du bsgrub pa dang*/ skye bdun sha la brten nas rdzas mchog rten 'dus ril bu bsgrub pa dang gnyis kyi dang po sman sgrub ltar na/ saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du mṛ ta ni 'chi ba la 'jug cing*/ de'i gong du dag pa'i a yig sbyar bas a mṛ ta zhes 'chi med kyi dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bsgrub par bya ba la rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba ste/ rtsa ba brgyad la'ang phyi'i rtsa ba brgyad/ nang gi brgyad/ gsang ba'i brgyad/ de kho nyid kyi brgyad do/ yan lag stong ni/ bdud rtsi dri chen la rigs nyi shu/

byang sems la nyi shu/ maṃ sa la nyi shu/ rak+ta la nyi shu/ dri chu la nyi shu/ bdud rtsi lnga po de dag re re la nang tshan brgya brgya dang*/ 415)de lnga re re la skyobs brgya brgya ste lnga brgya tshan gnyis kyis yan lag stong du tshang zhing*/ gzhan yang rig 'dzin grub thob skyes chen rnams kyi sku sha sogs byin rlabs kyi rdzas rnam dag rnams tshul bzhin bsags nas/ rdo rje slob dpon 'dus par bcas pas tshom bu tshogs sgrub kyi sgrub gzhi phun sum tshogs pas gzhi bzung zhing*/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa tshul ldan gyis sgo nas sgrub pa chen po rtags mthong gi bar du bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi a mṛ ta 'di lta bus ni gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don dngos grub mtha' dag myur du thob par byed pa'i sman gyi nor bu rin po che nyid yin te/ rgyud las/ dam tshig rtsa ba rnam pa lnga*// yan lag yon tan bcas pa ni// rang gi rigs mthun bcas pa dang*// 'phrod dang skyobs kyi khyad par las// 416)rgyal po blon po dmangs lta bu// skad cig thug 'phrad bsten pas kyang*// tshe ring nad med bde ba dang*// langs tsho kha dog stobs dang gzi// 'phel zhing dbang po rig pa gsal// mkha' la 'gro zhing pha rol gyi// nus stobs gnod pas mi tshugs shing*// kun gyis bkur sti'i 'os su mthong*// khams dang zas kyis mi 'brel zhing*// sngon gyi rgyal ba che rnams kyi// rig pa 'dzin pa'i gral thob 'gyur// de nyid ma thob bar du yang*// nad dang gnod pas mi rdzi zhing*// gzhan la phan pa 'grub la sogs// yon tan chen po dpag med thob/ zhes sogs phan yon brjod kyis mi langs bar gsungs so/ yang skye bdun sha la brten nas rdzas mchog rten 'dus ril bur bsgrub par ltar na/ de yang rgyal ba thabs mkhas shing thugs rje bsam gyi mi khyab 417) pas/ 'gro ba rnams so so'i skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i gdul thabs sna tshogs par ston pa ni rmad du byung ba'i mdzad pa ste/

sku yis 'dul ba la sku/ chos kyi 'dul ba la chos/ zang zing gis 'dul ba la zang zing*/ sprul pa'am brda' dang thabs kyis 'dul ba la de dang de lta bus 'dul bar mdzad de/ mgo dang yan lag dbang po lnga dang sha khrag la sogs pa yang ltos med du sbyin nas smon lam mtshams sbyor gyi thabs dang thugs rje dpag tu med pas 'gro la phan bde rtsol ba ni rgyal ba rnams kyi chos nyid yin phyir/ srog chags des pa'i gtam rgyud sogs ston pa'i skye rabs rnams las byung ba bzhin dang*/ skabs 'dir ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis snyigs ma'i sems can chos kyis 'phongs shing ngan song mtha' med par 'khyams pa rnams brtse bas rjes su bzung 418)phyir rgya gar gyi yul du rigs ldan gyi bram ze lnga 'am gsum du sku sprul te/ sku'i sprul pa bram ze dung 'phreng can dang*/ gsung gi sprul pa bram ze pad+ma dkar po/ thugs kyi sprul pa bram ze dri med snying po rkang pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi sku sha 'gro ba gang gi khongs su song ba tsam gyis 'khor ba mtha' can du mdzad nas byang chub kyi go 'phang la myur du reg par 'gyur ba'i nus ldan du byin gyis brlabs pa'i skye bdun gyi sha de dag bod yul du gu ru rin po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bsnams nas ril bu'i sgrub pa mdzad cing*/ ril bu rnams la yang rje 'bangs so so'i phyag 'dzub kyi ri mo las grub pa'i āḥdang ma la sogs pa'i yig 'brus mtshan zhing ya mtshan pa'i rtags du ma dang bcas te gter kha so so'i rgya rim pa bdun gyis btab nas sbas pa rnams gter ston 419)na rim gyis gdan drangs pa'i dam rdzas de dag phab rgyun du bgyis shing*/ gzhan yang bka' gsar rnying gi skyes chen du ma'i byin brlabs rten rdzas sman bzang dang bsres pa ril bur byas nas/ sgrub gzhung so so las ji ltar bshad pa bzhin bsgrub pa'i skye bdun myong grol gyi ril bu 'di dag kyang 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i thabs zab bla na med pa yin te/

bka'i thang yig las/ rgyal sras phung po 'di yang don can te// shig gi snying tsam su yi ltor song ba// rmang po'i ltor song srid kyi dngos grub 'byung*// dbul po'i ltor song nor gyi dngos grub 'byung*// dad can ltor song chos kyi dngos grub 'byung*/ zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang ye shes rig pa mchog gi rgyud las/ ril bu su yi ltor song ba// tshe rabs gang dang gar skyes kyang*// spyan ras gzigs 420)dang 'bral mi srid// rdzas mchog reg mchog ngo mtshar che/ zhes dang*/ 'gro ba kun grol gyi rgyud las/ thugs rje'i phrin las shugs phyung pa// 'di nyid myong ba tsam gyis ni// bsgom mi dgos te myong grol lo/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin zhing*/ 'dir gang zag 'ga' zhig myong bas grol ba zhes pa blor mi shong bar log par blta bar byed mod kyang*/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje'i thabs 'phrul 'gag pa med pa'i phrin las kyi rnam par thar pa yin phyir log par bltar mi rung ste/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ 'di lta ste/ rig sngags dang sman dang khyud dpyad dang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i mthu ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thabs dang ting nge 'dzin dang rdzu 'phrul gyi spyod yul ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin zhing*/ de lta bu'i dgongs don ni rnying lugs gcig 421)pu yang ma yin te/ gsang sngags gsar ma'i rgyud sde las kyang gsal bar gsungs mod de/ kyai rdor gyi rgyud las/ skye ba bdun pa'ang de nas mtshon// dga' bral dga' ba la smod pa// lan bdun pas ni 'grub par 'gyur// de ni zos pa tsam gyis kyang*// skad cig nyid la mkha' spyod 'gyur/ zhes sogs dang*/ bde mchog sdom 'byung gi rgyud las/ skye ba bdun du 'byung ba yin// de nyid zos pa tsam gyis ni// lha yi gzugs ni 'dzin par 'gyur// mnom pa'am reg pa nyid kyis kyang*// gang zhig thig ler byas pa de// mod la 'grub par 'gyur ba nyid// ces sogs mtha' yas par gsungs shing*/

dngos su phyag len du yang dkar lugs kyi ril nag sa skya pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu/ 'brug lugs kyi 'ja' zug ma la sogs dam rdzas khyad 'phags dang*/ thugs rje 422)chen po'i sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i ma ṇi ril bu sogs ni chos lugs thams cad kyi phyag bzhes su mdzad bzhin pa yin tshe/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i myong grol kho na khungs ma dag pa'o zhes skur 'debs byed pa rnams ni chos spong gi las chen po nyid du shes zhing spang bar rigs so/ de ltar kun gzhi rgyu'i bdud rtsi dang*/ lam thabs kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyu mtshan mdo tsam brjod nas/ gsum pa 'bras bu ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zhes bya ba ni gzhi la mngon du gyur pa'i ye shes de kho na nyid chos kyi sku'i dgongs pa'i mthar thug zag med lam bden ngo bo nyid la bya ste/ bdud rtsi'i rgyud las/ ye shes snying po can rnams kyis// snod bcud dbyings su bsdus nas ni// thabs dang shes rab byin rlabs kyis// mtshan ma'i rnam shes yul dang bcas// rnam par rtog pa'i mtshan ma kun// dmigs su med par rtogs pa ni/ 423)/'dus ma byas pa'i bdud rtsi ste// dag pa'i bdud rtsi nyid du 'gyur/ ces dang*/ lde mig gi rgyud las/ bcud kyi rdo rje snying po 'di// bdag dang gzhan du brjod du med// bstan du med pa'i chos nyid ni// brjod du med par go bar gyis/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin bla na med pa'i rang byung gi ye shes don dam pa'i bden pa de kho na nyid kyi don rtogs tshe skye 'chi spong len dgag sgrub kyi mtshan 'dzin las 'das pa'i don la reg pa ni bde bshegs kun gyi thugs bcud mchog gi bdud rtsi yang dag pa'i dam pa'o/ de lta bu khyad par mchog tu 'phags 424)pa'i sgrub thabs las ji ltar byung ba ltar tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i byin rlabs dam rdzas 'di dag gi nang du/ skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi byin rlabs rten rdzas phabs rgyun gyi rigs ji lta bu bzhugs ce na/

thog mar gter kha rnams las byung ba'i dad rten gyi rigs la dang po de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srungs kyi ring srel 'di gnyis kyang las 'phro gling pa'i gter ma'o/ shākya'i dbang po'i ring srel/ rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje'i sgrub sman/ mkhas pa shrī singha'i sgrub sman/ 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyis bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu/ skye ba bdun pa bram ze dung rna can nam dung 'phreng can gyi sku sha/ bram ze dri med snying po'i sku sha/ gter ston mnga' bdag myang gi gter kha nas byon pa'i a mṛ ta gu ru rin po che nyid kyis bsgrubs par mdzad pa'i 425)phabs rgyun skye bdun a tham ma/ tshe chu/ tshe ril/ mkho mthing lha khang dang srin mo sbar rjes can gyi gter kha'i shog ser tshal bu/ mnga' bdag nyang nyid kyis bsgrubs pa'i skye bdun ril bu/ myang gi dbu skra/ gdung rus sogs bzhugs/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi gter ma slob dpon pad+ma dang bi ma la gnyis kyis bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi chos sman/ rje 'bangs grogs gsum gyis bsgrubs pa'i skye bdun/ mkhar chu phug ring nas bton pa'i bram ze skye bdun gyi sha ril/ nam mkha'i snying po'i dbu lo/ slob dpon yab yum gyi byang sems/ nam mkha'i snying po dang shel dkar rdo rje 'tsho yab yum kyi byang sems dkar dmar/ gu ru rin po che'i na bza'/ gtsang gi snar stod gsang phug nadas gdan drangs pa'i skye bdun a dam ma/ yang snying 'dus pa'i shog ser/ chos 426)drug sras mkhar ma'i shog ser/ gu ru chos dbang nyid kyis bsgrubs pa'i a mṛ ta dang skye bdun/ chos dbang gi sku sha tshems/ dbu lo/ na bza'/ sku gdung dril chas sogs bzhugs/ gzhan yang rig 'dzin rgod ldem can gyi gter ma'i skye bdun dang de nyid kyi bdud rtsi/ gter ston gu ru jo tshes zangs yag brag nas gdan drangs pa'i a dam ril bu/ gu ru ye shes khyung grags kyis rgya nag gong ma chen po'i sku tshe la dmigs nas brag rdo rje tshe brtan nas gdan drangs pa'i tshe chu ril bu dang skye bdun chen mo/

gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter ma gu ru yab yum gyi byang sems/ a mṛ ta/ nyi zla kha sbyor gyi tshe ril/ o rgyan gyi na bza'/ skye bdun a ma/ shog ser/ gtor sgrub kyi gtor ma/ gter ston nyid kyis bsgrubs sman snga phyi gnyis/ gdung rus/ na bza' sogs dang*/ gter ston 427)o rgyan gling pa'i gter kha'i slob dpon gyi na bza' zab ber/ rgyal sras lha rje'i sku sha/ slob dpon yab yum gyi byang sems tshe chu ril bu/ gter ston rdo rje gling pa'i gter ma'i skye bdun/ shog ser tshal bu/ de nyid kyi sku sha/ gter ston dri med lhun po'i gter ma/ o rgyan gyi na bza'/ skye bdun a ma/ tshe ril/ de nyid kyi sku sha/ gter ston dri med kun dga'i gter ma'i gu ru yab yum gyi dbu lo/ bram ze skye bdun gyi sha ril/ shog ser/ lha lcam pad+ma gsal gyi dbu thod tshal bu/ gter ston karma gling pa'i gter ma'i skye bdun/ a tham ril bu/ gter ston kun skyong gling pa'i gdung rus/ bsam gtan bde chen gling pa'i sku sha/ gter ston mdo sngags gling pa'i gdung rus/ gter ston las 'phro gling pa'i skye bdun/ rat+na gling pa'i gter kha'i o rgyan na bza'/ bdud rtsi chos sman/ skye bdun 428)tshe chu ril bu/ shog ser gyi tshal bu/ gter sgrom gyi dum bu/ gter ston nyid kyis bsgrubs pa'i chos sman/ skye bdun ril bu/ sku sha dbu klad/ gdung rus/ dbu skra/ bdud rtsi/ gter ston pad+ma gling pa'i gter kha'i o rgyan gyi na bza'/ lha lcam pad+ma gsal gyi dbu skra na bza'/ bdud rtsi chos sman/ bram ze dri med snying po'i sku sha ril bu/ gter ston de nyid kyi bsgrubs sman/ skye bdun ril bu/ bdud rtsi/ rig 'dzin mchog ldan mgon po'i sku sha/ dbu klad/ des bsgrubs pa'i skye bdun/ gter ston bstan gnyis gling pa'i gter ma skye bdun a rgya ma/

chos sman/ tshe chu/ gter ston byang chub gling pa'i gter ma skye bdun a ma/ 'gro mgon dung mtsho ras pa'i sku sha ril bu/ rgyal sras zla bas gdan drangs pa'i skye bdun/ sprul sku chos kyi dbang pos 'dan yul a sho brag nas 429)gdan drangs pa'i tshe chu/ rje rin po che phun tshogs kyi gter ma'i chos sman/ de nyid kyis bsgrubs pa'i a mṛ ta dang skye bdun/ de nyid kyi sku sha ril bu/ 'phreng po gter ston shes rab 'od zer gyis gdan drangs pa'i gu ru'i na bza' skye bdun a ma/ de nyid kyi dbu lo/ dbu klad/ rig 'dzin zhig po gling pa'i gter ma dam rdzas rol pa chen po/ ma bsgom sangs rgyas myong grol/ thabs shes rgya can gyi ril bu/ bdud rtsi chos sman/ tshe chu ril bu/ gter ston de nyid kyi na bza'/ gdung thal gsang chab ril bu/ sgrub sman/ skye bdun/ gter ston pad+ma rig 'dzin rtsal gyi gter ma'i a tham ma/ rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' tshon snying po'i gter ma a dam ma rigs gsum gu ru yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar/ tshe chu ril bu/ bram ze dri med snying po'i 430)sku sha lhad med/ shog ser tshal bu/ gter ston de nyid kyis bsgrubs pa'i chos sman rigs bzhi skye bdun ril bu sogs bzhugs/ gzhan yang*/ mkhan po bodhi satwa'i sku sha/ na bza'/ phyag mkhar/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i zhabs chags/ khri srong lde'u btsan gyi zab ber/ ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi na bza' dang pad+ma rak+ta/ shangs tshal/ nam mkha'i snying po'i na bza'/ bai ro tsā na'i phyag bris shog ser tshal bu/ 'brog mi dpal gyi ye shes kyi sku sha/ rma rin chen mchog gis pha wong zan ltar brdzis nas gsol ba'i gsol ras/ kaḥthog dam pa bde bshegs kyi snam sbyar/ bdud rtsi chos sman/ mnga' bdag myang gi sras 'gro ba'i mgon po'i gdung rus/ sgrub sman/ myang ta thā ga ta'i gdung rus/ sku sha/ dbu lo/ chos dbang gi sras pad+ma dbang chen

431)gyi sku sha/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i sras ye shes rdo rjes bsgrubs pa'i a mṛ ta/ rat+na gling pa'i sras tshe dbang grags pa'i sgrub sman/ sku sha/ dbu skra/ sras mtha' yas grags pa'i dbu zhwa/ sras ngag dbang grags pa'i sku sha/ pad gling gi sras zla ba grags pa'i dbu lo/ shangs tshal/ gu ru chos dbang gi gdung rabs sprul sku chos kyi dbang po'i sku sha/ de nyid kyis sman sgrub brgyad cu rtsa gnyis mdzad pa'i phabs rgyun/ de sras kun bzang chos kyi rgyal pos bsgrubs pa'i a mṛ ta/ dkar chen kun grags kyis bsgrubs pa'i skye bdun rten 'dus/ chos rje sna tshogs rang grol gyis bsgrubs pa'i skye bdun/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis bsgrubs pa'i chos sman/ sangs rgyas dwags ston pa/ rgyal sras gnyan ston dpal 'byor dbang phyug 432)nam mkha' gu ru rnams kyis rim pa ltar bka' brgyad sman sgrub mdzad pa'i chos sman/ phreng rtse drung pa nam mkha' sangs rgyas kyis bsgrubs pa'i sman nag skal ldan yar klung sprul sku'i dbu thod/ rig ma sangs rgyas skyid kyi dbu thod/ kaḥthog rnam grol bzang po'i shangs tshal/ rin chen kun dga' lhun grub kyi gdung rus/ rig 'dzin chen po bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba'i gdung rus/ na bza'/ de nyid kyis nasgrubs pa'i chos sman/ dpal 'byor bstan 'dzin gyis bsgrubs pa'i a mṛ ta/ de nyid kyi ring srel/ rdzogs chen bsod nams rin chen gyi dbu bcing*/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin rdo rjes bsgrubs pa'i bka' brgyad dgongs 'dus sogs kyi sman sgrub rigs gsum/ rig 'dzin karma gu ru yab sras kyis bsgrubs pa'i chos sman phabs rgyun mnyam med sog zlog pa chen pos bsgrubs pa'i a mṛ ta/ bum chu ril bu/ snyim phu ba'i gdung rabs gter 433)ston nas bzung ste rgyal sras rig 'dzin snying po yan gyi bdud rtsi sman sgrub kyi phabs rgyun/

bya khyung pa dpal ldan seng ge nas thugs sras rgyal dbang bstan 'dzin yan gyi sgrub sman phabs rgyun/ gnam gong pa mi skyod rdo rjes gdan drangs pa'i tshe chu dang sgrub sman sogs kyi phabs rgyun/ gong rwa ba dpal skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po gzhan phan rdo rjes bsgrubs pa'i chos sman snga phyi sogs mdor na gsang sngags rnying ma'i rig 'dzin grub thob skyes chen mtha' dag gi byin rlabs rten rdzas phabs rgyun khungs btsun rnams bzhugs shing*/ gsang sngags gsar ma ltar na/ dpal tel+lo pas o rgyan yul gyi mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod nas gdan drangs pa'i dam rdzas myong grol chen po'i phabs rgyun/ tel+lo pa'i dbu skra/ dpal nā ro pa'i sgom thag rus rgyan rdog po/ dpal sha wa ri'i sgom thag 434)mai tri pa'i dbu zhwa/ mnga' bdag mar pa'i gdung rus/ dbu lo/ na bza'/ mar pa mgo yags kyi sku sha/ sras dar ma mdo sde'i sku mtshal/ rje btsun lho pa rta sgom gyi dbu zhwa/ rje mi la'i na bza'/ gdung thal/ jo bo rje'i sku chas/ shangs mtshal/ 'brom ston pa'i gdung rus/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i rnam sbyar/ pha dam pa'i na bza'/ rje sgam po pa'i gdung rus/ zhabs chags/ na bza'/ rje btsun ras chung pa'i ras kyi na bza'/ gsal ldong lgam sho'i na bza'/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i dbu zhwa/ 'gro ba'i mgon po zhang rin po che'i na bza'/ zhabs chags/ lha ri sde snod 'dzin pa'i gdung rus/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa nas bzung ste rgyal mchog chos dbyings rdo rje yan gyi karma pa na rim bcu'i dad rten gyi 435)rigs mtha' dag pa dang*/ ril nag chen mo/ zhwa dmar ba sku skye ba drug gi bar gyi dbu lo na bza' sogs dang rten du ma dang*/ grub thob gling ras nas bzung ste ra lung ngag dbang chos rgyal yan gyi dbu lo na bza' gdung rus sogs mtha' yas pa dang*/ stod 'brug rgyud pa'i grub thob du ma zhig gi byin rlabs rten dang*/

sa skya'i rje btsun grags rgyal gyis bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu/ rje btsun sa paṇa gyi ring srel gyis gtso byas pa'i 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud rnams nas bla chen chos kyi rgyal po yan gyi byin rlabs rten ma tshang ba med pa dang*/ gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa chen po'i dbu lo dang bdud rtsi ril bu/ 'gos lo dang khrus khang lo tsā gnyis kyi bdud rtsi ril bu/ kun mkhyen dol po 436) ba'i dbu lo/ rje zha lu lo chen gyi bdud rtsi ril bu/ ma lab sgron gyi na bza'/ de sras thod smyon bsam 'grub kyi dbu zhwa/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i dbu ral/ na bza'/ gtsang smyon pa'i rus rgyan/ dbus smyon pa'i gdung thal/ kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal bas 'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs pa'i sgrub ril/ dpal gtsug lag phreng bas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu/ dbu lo/ na bza'/ gsang chab ril bu/ mchog sprul nor bu brgyan pa'i dbu lo/ de nyid kyi yang zab kyi sgo nas tshe sgrub mdzad pa'i tshe chu ril bu/ mdor na gangs can gyi mkhas grub skyes chen lung zin yongs grags mtha' dag gi byin rlabs rten rdzas rtsod med khungs btsun rnams ma tshang ba med pa lta bur bzhugs 437)pa yin zhing*/ de dag kyang lhad med yin min the tshom som nyi can gyi rigs rnams dor te the tshom bral ba'i skyes chen dam pa kho na'i phyag nas byung ba rnams rags bsdus su dkar chag 'dir bkod pa yin la/ gzhan du na chos sman skye bdun bdud rtsi ril bu sogs 'di dag re re'i nang du'ang dam rdzas khyad 'phags kyi rigs ci tsam zhig yod par byed cing*/ skye bdun gyi sha gcig pu'i phan yon kyang rgyud sde dang sgrub thabs man ngag las bsam gyi mi khyab par gsungs phyir/ nang tshan gyi zhib dbye dang rnam grangs phan yon sogs ni bdag cag so so skye bos brjod par ji ltar nus la/

der yang ma zad rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub ljon shing dang*/ chu bo nai rañjā na'i bye ma sogs rgya gar gyi gnas chen thams cad kyi sa sna rdo sna 438)la sogs dang*/ gangs ti se man/ rgya la seng gtam yan/ ri bo rtse lnga tshun gyi gnas chen gtsug lag rten gsum khyad par can gyi sa rdo chu shing khrus chab ril bu sogs byin rlabs kyi rdzas rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mchis pa'i phabs rgyun dam rdzas rten 'dus 'di dag 'gro ba gang dang gang gi khong du song ba'am dri tsam tshor bas kyang*/ gnas skabs su nad gdon nyer 'tshe'i gnod pa las skyobs shing las nyon gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag pa dang*/ mthar thug bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'i byin rlabs kyi nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ mi phyed pa'i dad pas bstan cing gsol ba 'debs pa dang dngos grub blang ba la 'bad par bya'o/ thugs rje nus pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal ba yi// phrin las thogs med rdzu 'phrul las 'grub pa'i// ngo mtshar myong grol zag med bdud rtsi'i mchog / 439)skal ldan gdul bya'i dpal du 'bar ba 'di// snyigs dus 'gro ba tshe thung nad mang zhing*// rmi lam lta bu'i mi tshe yud tsam 'di'ang*// chos dang bral zhing sdig chen nyer spyad pas// ngan 'gro thug med 'khyams pa sha stag la// dgongs nas rgyal mchog pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs// 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rnams kyi legs bstsal ba'i// dngos grub gong bur gyur ba'i nor bu la// skal bzang skye dgu gus pas cis mi spyod// de slad yid ches lo rgyus dkar chag 'di// bdag 'dra rnam dpyod blo gros mi ldan kyang*// rig 'dzin gong ma'i phyag bzhes gsung rgyun gyi// rjes 'brang lhag bsam dag pas 'di bkod pa'i// dge ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad kyi// rnam dkar phung po ji snyed yongs bzlums nas// rang don zhi bde'i bsam pa ma yin par// gzhan don kho nar bsngos kun myur 'grub shog

byin rlabs dam rdzas kyi dkar chag stong thun mdor bsdus pa 'di nyid don gnyer mang pos nye bar bsku+ul pa la brten nas/ snyigs ma'i dus las kyang ches snyigs su gyur pa'i dus 'dir chos smra ba'i ming 'phral babs pa'i bla ma dkor gyis 'tsho ba mkhas mchog pad+ma legs grub rtsal zhes bgyi bas bkod pa phyogs dus kun tu dge legs su gyur cig/ dge'o//
